Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Fixes
- Fixed a regression introduced in the previous update that could carry an ended status, such as Damage Down, into a later death's details.
- Statuses now clear after multiple complete captures confirm they have ended, while one missed capture will not clear them prematurely.
